_comment: The behaviour-graph files CIGAR's modules were last confirmed against, by md5 of the file that
wins MO2's VFS. Pandora rewrites these in place on every run, so a run made for an unrelated
mod can silently change what CIGAR depends on. verify_deploy.py fails when a hash differs.
After re-running Pandora and re-testing the module named below, record the new hash with

The earlier confirmed copy (cb3a5b03..., test 12, 20 of 20) is build/mt_behavior.jujutsu-good.hkx and C:/TAKEALOOK/_backups/2026-09-28 pandora before sbf2. See docs/012-jujutsu.md.
